## otelgin automatic instruments (otelgin v0.69.0)

`otelgin.Middleware("markpost")` (main.go) emits three histograms per request through the otel semconv HTTPServer. `http.server.active_requests` is not among them — it is markpost's own middleware instrument above.

| Name                             | Type      | Unit | Attributes                                                                                                                                           | Notes |
| -------------------------------- | --------- | ---- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `http.server.request.duration`   | histogram | `s`  | http.request.method, http.response.status_code, http.route, server.address, server.port, network.protocol.name, network.protocol.version, url.scheme | —     |
| `http.server.request.body.size`  | histogram | `By` | http.request.method, http.response.status_code, http.route, server.address, server.port, network.protocol.name, network.protocol.version, url.scheme | —     |
| `http.server.response.body.size` | histogram | `By` | http.request.method, http.response.status_code, http.route, server.address, server.port, network.protocol.name, network.protocol.version, url.scheme | —     |

## Runtime instruments (contrib/instrumentation/runtime v0.71.0)

`go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/runtime` is started by `observability.Init` in both OTLP and file mode. `OTEL_GO_X_DEPRECATED_RUNTIME_METRICS` is never set, so the deprecated `runtime.go.*` family is not produced.

| Name                    | Type    | Unit           | Attributes              | Notes                                  |
| ----------------------- | ------- | -------------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `go.memory.used`        | gauge   | `By`           | memory.type=stack/other | —                                      |
| `go.memory.limit`       | gauge   | `By`           | —                       | observed only when a GOMEMLIMIT exists |
| `go.memory.allocated`   | gauge   | `By`           | —                       | —                                      |
| `go.memory.allocations` | counter | `{allocation}` | —                       | —                                      |
| `go.memory.gc.goal`     | gauge   | `By`           | —                       | —                                      |
| `go.goroutine.count`    | gauge   | `{goroutine}`  | —                       | —                                      |
| `go.processor.limit`    | gauge   | `{thread}`     | —                       | —                                      |
| `go.config.gogc`        | gauge   | `%`            | —                       | —                                      |

## VictoriaMetrics reconciliation

Not queried — run `metricsdoc -live <vm-base-url>` to add a presence column from `/api/v1/metadata`.

The `--live <vm-base-url>` flag adds a supplementary presence column reconciled against VictoriaMetrics `/api/v1/metadata`; it is informational and never part of the gates.
